card.name: Start of split longer words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split mid-way, such as celib- (celibate, celibacy), -oper (operating, postoperatively), tantal- (tantalize), impass- and cres- (crescent).

modes.description: The oper piece after a hyphenated prefix like self, post or non.

modes.label: Other word openings
modes.description: Opening pieces of rarer words such as tantalize, impassioned and crescent.
